record.title: Compare observed cached identity with stock derivation and acquired Key.data
record.intent: Establish offline coherence of physical identity and previously acquired key state without installing options.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before execution. Use preserved physical samples and acquired files only; no specimen connection.
Pin stock native bytes and physical evidence. Recover the exact DNA-to-key computation and compare predicted words with observed file keys, including sentinel and byte-order controls.

Locate acquired Key.data with archive/member provenance. Evaluate stock-compatible decoding with observed keys and independent controls; preserve unknown format or mismatch rather than treating printable output as proof.

Where original stock computation is executed use bounded instruction emulation or a disposable guest; declare any relocation/TLS setup and stop at unknown calls. Preserve originals and keep unit identities, keys and decoded payloads private.
Report derivation match, record structure and uncertainties separately from entitlement state, FRAM, physical installation and persistence. Commit/push conclusion before decision.
acceptance: Offline coherence or a precise mismatch is established with reproducible private evidence and redacted conclusions.
